entities.summary: Boazi (Bwadji), also known as Kuni after one of its dialects, is a Papuan language spoken in the Western Province of Papua New Guinea by the Bwadji people in the vicinity of Lake Murray and is written using the Latin script, with ⟨æ⟩ for, ⟨ø⟩ for, and ⟨꞉⟩ for vowel length. Some recordings of songs and stories have been made in this language.
